name: cube-single-play
label: Cube, single (play)
title: Cube
sub: ABI's critic was trained once, without rewards and without an actor. At test time it ranks or guides the action chunks of a frozen base policy so that the arm moves the cube to the target you place.

name: antmaze-medium-navigate
label: AntMaze medium (navigate)
title: AntMaze
sub: ABI's critic was trained once, without rewards and without an actor. At test time it ranks or guides the action chunks of a frozen base policy toward the goal you place.

name: dmc-quadruped
label: Quadruped
title: Quadruped
sub: ABI's critic was trained once, without rewards and without an actor. Switch the task at any time, also while the agent moves: ABI only reads the new reward labels of its reference states, nothing is retrained.
